skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray with cardiomegaly and pulmonary artery abnormalities in the context of pulmonary hypertension to determine the causal relationship between findings.
steps: Assess the cardiac silhouette for global enlargement (cardiomegaly) and specifically evaluate the right heart border and main pulmonary artery segment for prominence or dilation.
Identify any focal outpouchings or irregularities along the pulmonary artery contour that suggest pseudoaneurysm formation.

Synthesize findings by applying the pathophysiological principle that chronic pulmonary hypertension causes right ventricular pressure overload (leading to cardiomegaly) and simultaneous vascular wall stress (predisposing to pseudoaneurysm), thereby establishing the cardiomegaly as a secondary consequence of the underlying hypertensive disease process rather than an incidental or acute event.
